dialogues.speaker: Ahes
dialogues.text: I've been sorting through Captain Basil's navigation maps. It's been tough going, but it's also been really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Ahes
dialogues.text: I've learned about many lost ports through reading other stories in the past, and I've been able to approximate their locations through her records and the clues she left.

dialogues.speaker: Ahes
dialogues.text: Still, there are some things I don't quite understand...
